_comment: PROJECT-SCOPED MCP configuration. This file is committed to the repository,
so every teammate gets these servers automatically on clone or pull.
1. Secrets are NEVER written here. ${VAR} is expanded from the environment
at load time, which is what makes committing this file safe. Without
expansion, project scope would force you to choose between sharing the
2. Everything in this file is active at the same time as anything in the
user-scoped ~/.claude.json. Tools from all connected servers are
discovered together and offered to the agent simultaneously.
3. github and sentry below are COMMUNITY servers - the exam's guidance is to
adopt existing servers for standard integrations and reserve custom
implementations for team-specific workflows. 'support' is the custom one:
it fronts an internal system no community server could know about.
